name: Love☆Drops ~Miracle Doukyo Monogatari~
source: You always used to love listening to your grandmothers fairytales, and despite her recent death, her old european style mansion still remains a place of fond memories. So when the opportunity arises to actually live there on your own you jump at the chance...Only it turns out Grandmother's stories wern't quite as fictional as you thought, as you accidentally unleash three demons from their fifty year prison. And thus begins the "Miracle Cohabitation Story" as the three demons (a siren, a vampire and a werewolf), your three schoolmates (a genki underclassman, an aloof senior and your childhood friend) and a semi-secret character all vie for your affections.
translation: 你一直喜欢听祖母讲童话。尽管她最近去世了，那栋古老的欧式宅邸仍承载着许多温馨回忆。因此，当你得到独自住进去的机会时，毫不犹豫地答应了……然而事实证明，祖母的故事并不像想象中那样纯属虚构。你意外释放了3个被囚禁50年的恶魔。于是，“奇迹同居物语”就此开始：3名恶魔——海妖、吸血鬼与狼人——以及3名同学——活泼的低年级生、冷淡的高年级生与青梅竹马——再加上一名半隐藏角色，全都开始争夺你的感情。
